errors.text_span: промените в индекс на потребителските цени (ИЦН) на човек (в ППС) и БВП на човек (в ППС)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly combines the labels for the X and Y axes. The Y-axis is 'ИЦН' (Price Level Index), and the X-axis is 'БВП на човек (в ППС)' (GDP per capita in PPS). The description attributes 'на човек (в ППС)' to both, creating confusion.

errors.text_span: Оста X представлява годината, започваща от 1995 г. и достигаща до 2019 г.
errors.evidence: The X-axis does not represent the year. It represents 'БВП на човек (в ППС), EC28=100' (GDP per capita in PPS, EU28=100). The years 1995-2019 are the time period over which the data for each country's line is plotted, but time is not an explicit axis.

errors.text_span: Диапазонът на стойностите е от 1995 до 2019.
errors.evidence: This refers to the X-axis. The range of values on the X-axis is from 30 to 100, not 1995 to 2019.

errors.text_span: Оста Y показва ИЦН на човек (в ППС)
errors.evidence: The Y-axis shows 'ИЦН, ЕС28=100' (Price Level Index, EU28=100). The description incorrectly adds 'на човек (в ППС)' (per capita in PPS), which is part of the X-axis label.
The chart displays five distinct data series (lines), one for each of the five countries mentioned: Poland, Slovakia, Slovenia, Hungary, and Czechia.
The line for Poland (Полша) is grey, not yellow. The yellow line represents Slovenia (Словения).
The line for Slovenia (Словения) is yellow, not pink. There is no pink line in the chart.
The description hallucinates a pink line for Slovenia, which does not exist in the figure.

errors.text_span: Линията за Полша започва на приблизително 33 и се покачва до 87,0; 72,7.
errors.evidence: The line for Poland (grey) starts at approximately X=48, Y=45. The value '33' is incorrect. Furthermore, the endpoint coordinates '87,0; 72,7' are a misquoted version of the coordinates for Slovenia (87.0; 82.7).

errors.text_span: Линията за Словения започва на приблизително 33 и се покачва до 72,4; 59,5.
errors.evidence: The line for Slovenia (yellow) starts at approximately X=70, Y=70. The starting value '33' is completely wrong. Additionally, the endpoint coordinates '72,4; 59,5' belong to Slovakia, not Slovenia.

errors.text_span: Линията за Чехия започва на приблизително 65
errors.evidence: This statement is ambiguous as it only provides the approximate starting value for the X-coordinate (GDP per capita), omitting the corresponding Y-coordinate (Price Level Index), which is approximately 40.
The description fails to mention the prominent black diagonal line that represents the hypothetical equilibrium between income level and price level. This is a key feature for interpreting the chart.
The description omits any detailed information about the data series for Hungary (Унгария), which is represented by the orange line, despite listing it as one of the countries in the introduction.
